name: cash-return-on-equity
notes: Cash return on equity: OCF / book_equity. Cash-based analog to ROE: how much real cash each dollar of equity generates. Avoids NI accrual distortions. Distinct from ROE momentum (H221) and OCF/TA (H245). Clipped [-1.0, 5.0]. Sector-neutral top 20%, monthly rebalance.
